RBA copyright notice Section 5 (statistical data): commercial use permitted ('personal or commercial use') provided no RBA endorsement is implied; attribution required as 'Source: Reserve Bank of Australia [year]' or 'Source: RBA [year]'; (paraphrase) if you charge customers you must tell them the data is available from the RBA without an RBA fee; RBA may change or withdraw data without notice; not a benchmark. Notice does not address automated or bulk retrieval. Source: https://www.rba.gov.au/copyright/. Exchange-rates page (paraphrase) says data should not be relied on for regulatory or commercial purposes.
limitations: reference rates, not executable rates | no stated lag | no documented API (scrape of CSV links is the only machine route; automated access position unconfirmed) | currency list changes over time
